newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to March30.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to March30.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to March 30
The following is a one-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
MONDAY, MARCH 24
GRANADA, Spain - International Press Institute World Congress & 46th General Assembly. (second day of four-day conference)
BELFAST - Ulster TV releases 1996 full-year results
TUESDAY, MARCH 25
GRANADA, Spain - International Press Institute World Congress & 46th General Assembly. (third day of four-day conference)
LONDON - Microsoft chief executive Bill Gates launches new wave of Visual developer tools, Visual Studio 97. Docklands Arena. Contact: (44) 181 242 4129
LONDON - Hodder Headline Plc announces 1996 full-year results
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 26
GRANADA, Spain - International Press Institute World Congress & 46th General Assembly. (fourth day of four-day conference)
PARIS - Advertising, Sponsorship, Promotions: New Ways for Optimising Integrated Communications. Seminar organised by ESOMAR. Contact: (31) 20 664 2141
LONDON - Maiden Group Plc releases 1996 full-year results.
THURSDAY, MARCH 27
LONDON - Women With Attitude: Smart, Single & Spending conference, BAFT, 195 Piccadilly. Contact: (44) 171 413 4116
FRIDAY, MARCH 28
PARIS - Canal Plus shareholders' meeting
SUNDAY, MARCH 30
LONDON - Launch of Channel 5, Britian's fifth terrestrial television network.
-- London Advertising Newsdesk +44 171 542 2792
